definition: See which skills are available in Settings and turn one on or off.
outcome: a skill already present in this product is switched on (or off) for the account, so Claude will or will not load it; nothing has been run to check it

records.outcome: the member sees their skills and has switched one on or off in Claude Desktop
steps: Turn a listed skill on or off

evidence.quote: Open **Customize** in the sidebar, then **Skills**, to see your skills and turn any of them on or off.
